cases.name: perfect_forecast
cases.note: p equals the outcome: Brier 0, skill 1, ECE 0

cases.name: constant_half
cases.note: p = 0.5 with half hits: Brier 0.25 = climatology, skill 0

cases.name: constant_half_all_hits
cases.note: all hits: climatology 0, so skill is null (zero denominator)

cases.name: skill_and_bins
cases.note: ten equal bins, p = 1.0 lands in the last bin, bin [0.2,0.3) stays empty (null hit rate), Wilson per bin

cases.name: ece_holdout
cases.note: first 70% calibrated, last 30% under-confident: ece_raw differs from ece_raw_holdout 0.2 -> failed

cases.name: boundary_overlap
cases.note: holdout samples whose as_of falls inside a training target window (issuer B's ends on day 220) are dropped

cases.name: macro_daily_91
cases.note: daily as_of with 91-day target windows: one independent sample per 91 days per region (US days 0/91/182, CN 0/91)

cases.name: same_stock_dedup
cases.note: daily calls on one stock with 5-day windows keep days 0 and 5; same-day windows on another stock keep all ten

cases.name: embargo_0
cases.note: windows of 10 days every 11 days do not overlap: all ten independent

cases.name: embargo_2
cases.note: embargo_days = 2: the next as_of must be after window_end + 2 days, so every other one

cases.name: g01_counterexample
cases.note: raw p is 0.12 off in both groups: ece_raw_holdout 0.12 > 0.10 while the isotonic-mapped holdout ECE is ~0 -> failed (the gate tests raw p)

cases.name: acceptance4_100
cases.note: acceptance example 4: 100 independent samples, holdout raw ECE ~0 and skill > 0 -> calibrated; open/void/withdrawn/retrospective rows are only counted

cases.name: acceptance4_99
cases.note: acceptance example 4: the same cohort without its last sample: 99 independent -> insufficient

cases.name: categorical_calibrated
cases.note: accuracy ~0.9 against a majority baseline ~0.3: Wilson low above majority_rate -> calibrated; margin_pp bins [0,5) [5,15) [15,100], one margin missing per 5

cases.name: categorical_failed
cases.note: always predicting the majority class: accuracy 0.7 = majority_rate, Wilson low below it -> failed

cases.name: interval_failed
cases.note: coverage 0.63 vs nominal 0.8 (gap > ece_max) -> failed; width_ratio against the per-subject empirical quantile width

cases.name: interval_calibrated
cases.note: coverage 0.8 = nominal, narrow intervals (width_ratio < 1) -> calibrated

cases.name: score_ties
cases.note: Spearman with average ranks over tied values; tertiles by value; evaluated

cases.name: score_insufficient
cases.note: the same cohort under threshold_n = 100: insufficient

cases.name: score_binary
cases.note: binary realized metric: tertile hit rates with Wilson

cases.name: gate_skill_not_positive
cases.note: n = threshold, holdout 30 >= 20, holdout ECE 0 <= 0.10 but constant p = base rate gives skill exactly 0 -> failed (skill > 0 is part of the gate)

cases.name: gate_skill_negative
cases.note: holdout ECE 0.033 <= 0.10 but constant p = 0.5 against a 14/30 holdout base rate: brier_skill_holdout < 0 -> failed

cases.name: gate_skill_null
cases.note: holdout all hits: climatology 0, brier_skill_holdout null while holdout ECE 0.05 <= 0.10 -> failed, not calibrated

cases.name: gate_holdout_small_after_drop
cases.note: 101 independent samples but the 31-sample holdout loses 15 to the boundary overlap drop: 16 < 20 -> holdout metrics null -> insufficient

cases.name: gate_holdout_20
cases.note: n = 64: train 44, holdout exactly 20 = HOLDOUT_MIN -> holdout metrics computed, calibrated

cases.name: gate_holdout_19
cases.note: n = 63: train 44, holdout 19 < 20 -> holdout metrics null -> insufficient

cases.name: gate_ece_equals_max
cases.note: holdout (32): p 0.25 hit rate 0.125, p 0.75 hit rate 0.875 -> ECE exactly 0.125 = ece_max (binary-exact) and skill 0.5 -> calibrated (<=)

cases.name: interval_wide_gap_ok
cases.note: coverage 0.8 = nominal (gap 0 <= ece_max) but intervals wider than the empirical quantile baseline (width_ratio > 1) -> failed
